name: Pseudovampirism
source:
In a small Tennessee town, Lucas meets Allison, a girl who drifts between fantasy and reality. She introduces him to a vampire role-playing crew, where only one girl is truly serious. Together, they face the ups and downs of middle school – and of growing up.

[From [url=https://sumenocremepuff.itch.io/pseudovampirism-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在田纳西州的一个小镇上，卢卡斯遇到了艾莉森，一个徘徊在幻想与现实之间的女孩。她向他介绍了一个吸血鬼角色扮演团队，其中只有一个女孩是真正认真的。他们一起面对中学和成长的坎坷。

[来自[url=https://sumenocremepuff.itch.io/pseudovampirism-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
